description:
Rotary Club of Bombay Uptown
Project: Wisdom Wednesday Quiz Contest
In association with Rotaract Club of Bombay Uptown

To promote continuous learning, Rotary awareness, and member engagement, the Rotary Club of Bombay Uptown in association with the Rotaract Club of Bombay Uptown, launched the Wisdom Wednesday Quiz Contest from the first week of July 2026

Every Wednesday participants receive 7 exciting questions covering

*Rotary Knowledge
*Current Affairs
*General Knowledge

The quiz will continue throughout the Rotary year encouraging members to stay informed learn something new every week and enjoy healthy competition

The topperforming participants over the year will be recognized and rewarded with exciting prizes

This unique initiative reflects the Rotary spirit of learning fellowship and creating lasting impact by inspiring members to grow in knowledge while strengthening their connection with Rotary

Create Lasting Impact through Learning
Knowledge Shared is Service Multiplied
